scores.rationale: Standard out-of-print Australian art pottery reference, steady market roughly $100-200.
About 22 AWM wartime annuals, each worth little but a decent lot, roughly $80-150.
Bert Stern Last Sitting large Schirmer book, out of print, typically $150-250 used.
Few Power Records sets, duplicates and missing records limit value to about $40-80.
Genuine 1900 Cyclopedia of Tasmania, keenly sought, but damaged bindings and loose text block cut it to about $250-450.
Long run of Art and Australia including Vol 1 No 1, but common journal, about $100-200 for two boxes.
1879 Meredith Our Island Home with autotype plates, scarce; worn and foxed so about $250-450.
Cassell Second World War set plus World Crisis, common and worn, about $80-150.
Mostly low-value insect books; McCubbin Butterflies with torn jacket is the main item, about $50-90.
